class.name: ProgressBarServer
class.brief_description: A server for many world-space progress bars, such as health bars over units.

method.name: bar_create
method.description: Creates a bar drawn with [param style] as a child of [param parent]'s canvas item and returns its [RID]. New bars are full (ratio [code]1.0[/code]). Returns an empty [RID] if [param parent] or [param style] is [code]null[/code].

method.name: bar_free
method.description: Frees the bar and its canvas item.

method.name: bar_get_ratio
method.description: Returns the fill ratio of the bar, between [code]0.0[/code] and [code]1.0[/code].

method.name: bar_set_modulate
method.description: Multiplies the colors of the bar with [param color], for example to tint enemy bars red. Does not redraw the bar.

method.name: bar_set_offset
method.description: Moves this bar by [param offset] in addition to [member ProgressBarStyle.offset], for example to stack a mana bar below a health bar that share a style.

method.name: bar_set_ratio
method.description: Sets the fill ratio of the bar. The value is clamped between [code]0.0[/code] and [code]1.0[/code]. The bar is redrawn only if the ratio changes.

method.name: bar_set_style
method.description: Draws the bar with another style, for example when a unit changes its team.

method.name: bar_set_visible
method.description: Shows or hides the bar. A bar is also hidden when its parent is hidden, and by [member ProgressBarStyle.hide_when_full] and [member ProgressBarStyle.hide_when_empty].

method.name: bars_set_ratios
method.description: Sets the ratios of many bars in one call: [code]bars[i][/code] gets [code]ratios[i][/code]. Both arrays must have the same size. Useful for data-oriented game code that updates thousands of units per frame.

method.name: get_bar_count
method.description: Returns the number of bars that exist.
